chunks: Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them:
Regarding a man who killed his father,
He, peace be upon him, said: "He does not inherit from him. And if the killer has a son, the son inherits from the murdered grandfather."

key_terms.ابْنٌ: A son; here, the son of the killer.
key_terms.الْجَدَّ الْمَقْتُولَ: The murdered grandfather; the slain father from whom the grandson inherits.
key_terms.لَا يَرِثُهُ: He does not inherit from him; a ruling of exclusion from inheritance.
key_terms.لِلْقَاتِلِ: The killer; the one who committed the act of killing.

ai.seo_question: Does a son who kills his father lose the right of inheritance, and can his own son still inherit from the grandfather?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that a person who kills his father is barred from inheriting from him. It also clarifies that this prohibition does not extend to the killer’s son, who may inherit from his slain grandfather.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5683 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), regarding a man who killed his father.
Imam (as) said: "He does not inherit from him. However, if the killer has a son, the son inherits from the murdered grandfather."
